reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality lies in parallel expert auditing versus individual validation. Each expert panel operates in isolation, ensuring independence and reducing collusion risks. The system's robustness hinges on complete line-by-line scrutiny, where each component must be verified for strategic utility and alignment. Mis-ranking or under-leveraging invalidates the entire framework. Confidence discrimination surfaces introduce a secondary layer of verification, yet they are often misinterpreted as direct predictors. Their true function is to provide a calibrated signal only when activated, distinguishing them from raw model outputs. The failure mode arises when these distinctions are blurred—leading to overconfidence in misaligned metrics or premature conclusions about model performance.
